下面表单默认隐藏邮寄明细，明细值会保留；隐藏时不参与必填校验。按钮只会生成可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,ask])
$on: boolean = false
$name: string = ""
$detail: string = "保留内容"
form = Form(children=[toggle,nameField,detailField], title="邮寄地址")
toggle = Switch(label="填写邮寄明细", bind=$on)
nameField = TextField(label="收件人姓名", bind=$name, required=true, placeholder="请输入姓名")
detailField = TextField(label="邮寄明细", bind=$detail, required=true, visible=$on, multiline=true)
ask = Button(label="生成检查草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请检查此邮寄地址表单，确认姓名与邮寄明细是否完整。", context={"name":$name,"enabled":$on,"detail":$detail}))
```
